+    return 0 if total >= Decimal("100") else 10

@@

     assert below.stdout == "10\n"
+    assert at_boundary.returncode == 0
+    assert at_boundary.stdout == "0\n"
     assert above.returncode == 0
     assert above.stdout == "0\n"
